scope: From the claimant's seat: the need for a claim (s 11) and where it may be made (ss 29, 30, 30A, 31, 31A as a fact); the deemed claim day after contacting the Department (s 13); the start day (Schedule 2 cll 3(1), 4(1), (2), (6), 5(1); cl 4A not covered); deemed rejection of an undecided claim (s 39(1), (3)-(5)); the severe financial hardship advance (s 51(1), (4)); what to report and by when (ss 66A, 72(3)(a), (b), (6), 74); participation payment compliance for persons other than declared program participants (ss 42AC(1), (1A), 42AD, 42AE, 42AF, 42AG, 42AL, 42AM, 42AO, 42AP(2), (3), (5)); the date of effect of an adverse determination (s 118(2), (5), (7)-(9), (11), (13)); review (ss 109(1)-(3), 126, 129, 131, 135, 142, 144, 147 items 1 and 8). Out: special payments and their claims (ss 12-12K, 17-27B, 46-50A, 59); employment pathway plan content and exemptions (Division 2A); declared program participants (Division 3A); payment mechanics (ss 43-62) beyond s 51; tax file numbers (ss 75-77); the automatic cancellations, suspensions and rate reductions (ss 90-106B) and ss 80-85 beyond s 118; concession cards beyond s 11; nominees (Part 3A); income management (Parts 3AA, 3B); schooling requirements (Part 3C); information gathering, confidentiality, offences beyond s 74, and machinery. Qualification, rates and debts are the 1991 Act's.
seat: the claimant: the person who claims, receives or has received a social security payment, including the jobseeker with mutual obligations
